staticText: Country-programme finder and vaccination-visit question brief only. National schedules, vaccine products, ages, intervals, campaigns and catch-up rules change. The tool must not output a universal fixed schedule, calculate due or overdue dates, generate a catch-up plan, advise restarting or continuing a series, recommend or withhold a vaccine, decide a contraindication, interpret a product, assess an adverse reaction, or label anyone complete, protected, eligible or up to date. It may accept only a country, broad age band, clarification reason and optional product wording copied from a record, then provide a dated official-programme or WHO country-reported schedule handoff and neutral questions for a qualified provider. No name, birth date, school, clinic identifier, medical-record number, address or contact detail is needed. Entries remain in the browser and are not stored or sent to AI, analytics, email, a profile, a share URL or a server. Print-to-PDF and text export are local and ungated. Severe breathing difficulty, wheezing, face/lip/throat swelling, collapse, seizure, blue lips, shock or unresponsiveness after vaccination requires immediate local emergency care; the tool must not triage or provide treatment. Sources checked 2026-07-26: WHO Immunization Data vaccination schedules, WHO routine-immunization summary tables, CDC preventing and managing adverse reactions, WHO anaphylaxis after immunization, and the configured official country programme pages.
